title: Unnamed major: 'We got it from them'
place_text: Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, Florida

tellings.quote: He looked at me and went, "We got it from them."

plain: Greg Rogers, a doctor who worked with NASA, the US space agency, says that in 1992 at Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, a military launch site in Florida, he spoke with an Air Force major whose name he does not give. According to Rogers, the major looked at him and said, "We got it from them." If true, it would mean the military had something it obtained from non-human visitors.
